sourceNote: A copy of assets/models/pig/pig-upper.glb (armSource) with new quad tubes on each arm from the shoulder line to the wrist, 1.5 times longer than the arms of the source. tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py --factor 1.5 makes these faces. The other faces and pig-upper.glb stay unchanged.
armSourceNote: A copy of assets/models/pig/pig.glb with round upper arms (assets/models/pig/README.md). The mesh has no upper arm of its own, so tools/blender/pig_arms.py removes the bulge of the trunk wall above each elbow, fills the wall again, and builds a round tube up to a closed dome around the shoulder joint. tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py reads it.
paintedNote: The weights of the clavicles and the arms are the automatic weights of Blender with the weight rules of tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py. The vertices on the bones of paintedLower keep the rule weights, as on the wolf, because the seated bind of the app depends on them.

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments, and each elbow and wrist a helper bone. The helper is twice the gap of the elbow rings of tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py (step_skeleton() prints it).

name: Pig

app.note: No reference image shows a pig, so the pig takes the size of its parametric body. The scale puts the standing skull top (0.9476 u) at 1.137 m, with the standing shoulder joints at 0.671951 m. The reach is the reach of the arm factor, from the shoulder joint to the middle of the palm.

armFactorNote: The factor 1 keeps the arm length, because the rig with arm segments does not stretch the arms. The arms of pig-arms.glb are 1.5 times longer than the arms of the source (arm_rebuild.py --factor 1.5), and the arm joints are the joints of the longer arms, so the reach stays app.reach. The long snout puts the horn far in front of the body, so the hold of the pig turns the horn back toward the body (SPECIES_WIND_HOLDS.pig of src/pose/winds.ts).
legFactorNote: The legs keep the length of the mesh. Do not stretch the legs: change the chair.

rootNormals.note: The skin faces whose middle lies within radius (units) of the head of an upper arm take the normals of the skin with no crease angle (root_rim() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py, studioNormals() of src/models/studio-normals.ts), as on the rhino. Thus the arm root shows no hard seam and no dark wedge. The arm faces from 0.1 units before each wrist joint to 0.025 units past it take the same normals, as on the bear: the supinated bind paw (studio.bindSupination) twists the bind forearm of the rebuilt round arm, and with no such rule a dark saw-tooth line showed under the right wrist and a dark slit on the back of the right paw, at rest and at a note.

jointsNote: The places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the tips of the ears, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The small curled tail is a ball on one bone at the back. The joints of the elbow, the wrist, and the paw are the joints of the longer arms of arm_rebuild.py --factor 1.5.

studio.bindArmsNote: With straightArms, bindArms.upper_arm sets the bind upper arm, and bindArms.forearm sets only the elbow axis: the cross product of the bind upper arm and this forearm direction (StudioBody.hinges, bind_hinges() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The two directions are the directions of the old bent bind of the horn, so the elbow axes and the zero of the roll of the upper arm stay.
studio.straightArmsNote: The bind keeps the arms of the source straight: the forearm and the paw keep the turn of the upper arm, so that the rest shape holds the bend of no role (the role-neutral bind of design 4.4).
studio.bindSupinationNote: The bind paw of each arm turns about its bind forearm toward supination (paw_supination() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), and the forearm segments share the turn. The values make the largest paw twist p95 of the six roles of the cast matrix and the horn smallest (design 4.4, pnpm bind-supination pig): L 118 degrees (the flute and the snare drum) against 165 with no supination (the horn), R 86 degrees (the cello and the horn) against 123. The rest right elbow of the horn hold points forward (restPoleR), so the hornist right paw twists 98 degrees at rest on R 51, and the right value is 64. A probe of the rig of L 102 and R 64 moves no side by more than 0.5 degrees.
studio.note: The seated posture of design 5.2: the thigh slopes 25 degrees down and 15 degrees out, so that the horn has room at the right knee, and the shin is vertical (tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 25 15 0). The foot and the toes keep the turn of the source, so that the soles stand flat on the floor.

armFree.note: The tube of each upper arm and the forearm have no face that joins them to the trunk. A vertex of the free arm lies beyond the plane, within 0.075 u of the chain of the arm joints, and above y 0.3, so that the wall under the arm and the belly beside the paw follow the trunk.

haunch.note: The part of the thigh weight that goes to the hips grows from 0 at the lower height to 1 at the upper height, so that the round haunch stays on the hips.

weights.note: Beyond the plane |x| = armSplit, only the free arm (armFree) follows the arm bones. The plane lies inside the tube at the shoulder joint, so that the whole tube is in the free arm. Above headFrom (the chin), each vertex follows the head only. earBase lies above the head, so the ears follow the head.

refine.ringsNote: The config has no rings. pnpm rig-mesh pig --check lists the thin faces near the joints as candidates for a ring (check.thin).

border.note: In the box of the trunk, from y 0.4 to the chin, each dark fur face takes the color of the nearest light fur face, so that no black sliver shows under the raised right arm. The dark hooves lie on the free arms, below the box.

tone.note: Each plain face takes the hue and the chroma of the species color of its band (SPECIES_COLORS.pig) and keeps its lightness, as for the panda. A row is [L, dL, da, db] in Oklab. The dark hooves and the snout disc keep their colors.

colors.note: A dark face in the eye box is an eye. The config has no nose box: the snout disc has no dark faces, and the front-most vertex of the head near the middle plane is the middle of the snout disc.

chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail. The half width holds the haunch. The front edge lies behind the short thighs, and the back edge holds the back of the haunch.

raise.note: The shape of the left arm on the valves, with the mean turns of the play samples of the hold with the elbow out (pnpm raise-fit hornist --faces 743,745 --side L). The faces of the inner left elbow fold in each play sample with no shape.

The shape of the bent left wrist on the valves (pnpm raise-fit hornist --faces 504,708 --side L --bone hand). The rule turns 10 degrees past the mean of the play samples. The right arm has no shape, because no face of it folds with the straight bind.
